text:
If they abide in inner emptiness,
they practice the actualization of inner emptiness,
but they do not practice the perfection of wisdom.
Blessed One, if bodhisattva great beings, when practicing the perfection of wisdom,
through a lack of skill in means, with a mind that abides in the view of self and possessions,
abide in outer emptiness,
they practice the actualization of outer emptiness,
but they do not practice the perfection of wisdom.
Blessed One, if bodhisattva great beings, when practicing the perfection of wisdom,
through a lack of skill in means, with a mind that abides in the view of self and possessions,
abide in outer and inner emptiness,
they practice the actualization of outer and inner emptiness,
but they do not practice the perfection of wisdom.
Blessed One, if bodhisattva great beings, when practicing the perfection of wisdom,
through a lack of skill in means, with a mind that abides in the view of self and possessions,
abide in the emptiness of emptiness,
they practice the actualization of the emptiness of emptiness,
but they do not practice the perfection of wisdom.
Blessed One, if bodhisattva great beings, when practicing the perfection of wisdom,
through a lack of skill in means, with a mind that abides in the view of self and possessions,
abide in the emptiness of the great,
they practice the actualization of the emptiness of the great,
but they do not practice the perfection of wisdom.
Blessed One, if bodhisattva great beings, when practicing the perfection of wisdom,
through a lack of skill in means, with a mind that abides in the view of self and possessions,
abide in the emptiness of the ultimate,
they practice the actualization of the emptiness of the ultimate,
but they do not practice the perfection of wisdom.

through a lack of skill in means, with a mind that abides in the view of self and possessions,
abide in the emptiness of the conditioned,
they practice the actualization of the emptiness of the conditioned,
but they do not practice the perfection of wisdom.

through a lack of skill in means, with a mind that abides in the view of self and possessions,
abide in the emptiness of the unconditioned,
they practice the actualization of the emptiness of the unconditioned,
but they do not practice the perfection of wisdom.
Blessed One, if bodhisattva great beings, when practicing the perfection of wisdom,
through a lack of skill in means, with a mind that abides in the view of self and possessions,
abide in the emptiness of the inexpressible,
they practice the actualization of the emptiness of the inexpressible,
but they do not practice the perfection of wisdom.
Blessed One, if bodhisattva great beings, when practicing the perfection of wisdom,
through a lack of skill in means, with a mind that abides in the view of self and possessions,
abide in the emptiness of non-things,
they practice the actualization of the emptiness of non-things,
but they do not practice the perfection of wisdom.
Blessed One, if bodhisattva great beings, when practicing the perfection of wisdom,
through a lack of skill in means, with a mind that abides in the view of self and possessions,
abide in the emptiness of intrinsic nature,
they practice the actualization of the emptiness of intrinsic nature,
but they do not practice the perfection of wisdom.
Blessed One, if bodhisattva great beings, when practicing the perfection of wisdom,
through a lack of skill in means, with a mind that abides in the view of self and possessions,
abide in the emptiness of all phenomena,
they practice the actualization of the emptiness of all phenomena,
but they do not practice the perfection of wisdom.
Blessed One, if bodhisattva great beings, when practicing the perfection of wisdom,
through a lack of skill in means, with a mind that abides in the view of self and possessions,
abide in the emptiness of self,
they practice the actualization of the emptiness of self,
but they do not practice the perfection of wisdom.

through a lack of skill in means, with a mind that abides in the view of self and possessions,
abide in the emptiness of phenomena,
they practice the actualization of the emptiness of phenomena,
but they do not practice the perfection of wisdom.
